name: Latitude Zephyr
tagline: A start-up from Reims: engine tests at SaxaVord, first launch now planned for late 2027
description: Zephyr is the small launcher of Latitude, a start-up in Reims, France. Its first version is meant to lift 100 kg to orbit, and 200 kg from 2028. Latitude has fired its Navier engine at SaxaVord Spaceport. On 2026-07-01 it signed a letter of intent with Etlaq, in Oman, for a first experimental launch from Etlaq Spaceport in late 2027. The company did not name the rocket in that announcement, so the name Zephyr may have been dropped. Work on its ELM-Diamant facility in French Guiana continues. Earlier launch targets, 2024, 2025 and 2026, have passed. It has never flown.
best_known_for: A start-up from Reims: Navier engine tests at SaxaVord, first launch now planned for late 2027 from Oman
